3151.translation: Being fooled because form change but substance remain same

3152.translation: Putting secondary thing before the main thing

3153.translation: Watching eagerly for chance to strike

3154.translation: Countless differences among people and things

3157.translation: Helpless, without way to handle the matter

3160.translation: Outside appearance different from inside; two-faced behaviour

3161.translation: Factory burn down, dem replace all equipment, and production speed double. So bad event turn to good fortune.

3162.translation: To understand four-character expression, read the surrounding clause. Cause-and-result wording show whether situation na luck, bad luck, excess or something worthy of praise.

3163.translation: Every New Year, I resolve to exercise, but I no last beyond three days. My plans always fade after few days.

3164.translation: Using bicycle go work give exercise and save transport money: two gains from one action.

3165.translation: Person wey break promise vex instead of apologising. Na extreme case of wrongdoer scolding the victim.

3166.translation: Exercise good for body, but ten hours every day fit make person sick. Too much fit bad like too little.

3167.translation: Both companies choose only favourable parts of same statistics and argue to suit themselves.

3168.translation: When student result pass teacher own, teacher happy say student don surpass master.

3169.translation: Studying old hanok structure and applying am to modern buildings na good example of learning new things from the old.

3170.translation: Rescue workers continue search day and night for missing people.

3171.translation: More people dey lose large money after sweet talk promise guaranteed capital and 20% monthly returns. Normal investment with higher return get higher risk. Promise of high return without risk should itself raise doubt. Instead of sweet words making us rush, first check whether firm register with official institution.

3172.translation: Food company hide known product defect, but internal whistleblower reveal everything. Plenty people feel relief and say justice always win. But correct final result no justify every part of process. Consumers don already get hurt, and weak oversight fit have kept truth hidden. Justice no win automatically; institutions and courage make am possible.

3173.translation: The more the better fit suit objects, but no necessarily information. More material seem to add evidence, but sorting useful parts also need more time and effort. Unclear-source material fit even blur conclusion. Wetin matter no be total amount, but choosing and using reliable material accurately.

3174.translation: People often comfort jobless people during recession with Saeongjima, about uncertain good and bad fortune and hope for better days. The old man for story no rush judge fortune when horse leave or return. But saying no mean sit idle wait for luck. Comfort no replace practical measures. Unemployed people need both calm attitude to uncertainty and real support, like retraining and income protection.

3175.translation: Company propose same total yearly salary but smaller basic pay and bigger performance bonus. Union call am Josammosa. Monkeys for story foolish because three morning or four morning still total seven daily. But salary plan get extra issue: bonus fit shrink with company performance, while basic pay affect severance and loan assessment. Same-looking total with different risk bearer no fit simply count as that trick.

3176.translation: Local festival attract more tourists every year. But resident-led events reduce while outside performers take centre stage. People criticise reversal of host and guest. Residents wey preserve tradition should be hosts, but visitor taste now decide content. More guests itself no be fault. Problem na pushing hosts out while welcoming guests. Success should depend on whether residents remain centre stage, no be visitor number alone.

3177.translation: People use Daegi-manseong, late-blooming great talent, oppose early gifted-child selection. Dem say no reject talent before e bloom. But this reply get gap: proverb describe successful late completion, no be countless people wey wait without success. Success stories alone no enough to decide selection time. Better question na whether selection happen only once or people get later chances too.

3178.translation: When people propose disaster-drill budget cuts, others reply with Yubi-muhwan, preparation prevents worry. Saying no wrong, but alone no persuasive enough. Successful prevention leave no visible accident. No accident fit mean drills work or drills never necessary. To convince budget officials, dem need estimates of damage without drills, no be slogan alone.

3179.translation: Manufacturer advertise green management heavily, but disclosure show emissions rise for same period. E easy to call am Pyori-budong, outside and inside no agree. But that judgment need knowledge of inside. If advert describe reduction plan still being implemented, gap with current figures fit be timing difference instead of deception. First check how specific plan be and whether company follow promises.

3180.translation: Long-working team fit understand each other without words. People call am Isim-jeonsim and ideal cooperation. But cost dey: unwritten shared standards fit disappear when members change. Belief say everybody know without talking fit also hide different understandings. This unspoken coordination work best only when important standards don already get written down.

3181.translation: Project launch big, but results almost nothing, so e end weakly.

3182.translation: Raw-material prices rise and exchange rates unstable too. With one problem after another, company postpone investment.

3183.translation: Judges give high score because candidate remain calm and adjust well even to unexpected questions.

3184.translation: Rivals dey watch for chance to take our market share, so no be time to relax.

3185.translation: That scholar get wide knowledge of history, astronomy and medicine.

3186.translation: Meeting mood fall because report dodge main question and talk unrelated matters.

3187.translation: Delaying decisions and changing opinions indecisively make team members trust hard to win.

3188.translation: If this contract fail, partner company almost certainly go stop dealings too.
